title: Collective Timeline Explorer: unified failed-request timeline and retry-cluster UX
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a single-pane 'Collective Timeline Explorer' for the Redwood Console that lets engineers investigate groups of failed requests and retries across rollout windows. The explorer aggregates requests into clusters (by error taxonomy and retry lineage), surfaces per-cluster cost and latency impact, and provides fast payload inspection, prefix/KV cache hints, and recommended retry strategies. This ticket captures the prototype, design rationale, reviewer feedback, and next steps for handoff to engineering.
problem_statement: On high-traffic rollouts customers must triage correlated failures across thousands of requests. Current consoles force users to jump between per-request traces, rollouts, and cost dashboards which slows root-cause discovery and increases mean-time-to-mitigate. There is no concise view that shows retry patterns, payload diffs and the cost of retries in the context of a rollout.
goals: Provide a single timeline view that aggregates related failures and retry groups
Expose error taxonomy and probable root cause signals without leaving the timeline
Show incremental cost and token consumption for retries and failed variants
Enable fast payload diffing and KV cache prefix suggestions to test hypotheses
Support canary/cutover correlation so PMs/Eng can evaluate rollout impact
success_metrics: Reduce time-to-identify primary root cause for correlated failures by 30% in internal tests
Increase number of issues resolved via console without creating a ticket by 25%
Surface retry-related cost delta per incident to within ±10% of billing reports
user_stories: As an on-call engineer I want to view clustered failed requests for a rollout window so I can prioritize the clusters with highest user impact
As an SRE I want to see the per-cluster token and dollar cost of retries to decide whether to throttle or change retry policy
As a PM I want to compare payload diffs across a retry lineage to validate whether new prompts or model variants caused regressions
design_decisions: Clusters are derived from a lightweight error fingerprint + request signature (model, route, truncated payload hash). This balances precision and performance for large rollups.
Primary timeline row groups by cluster; secondary rows show retry lineage collapsed into stack badges to reduce noise.
Show cost as a sparklines + per-cluster delta; link to the Cost Breakdown dashboard for per-token validation.
Inline payload diff panel shows normalized tokens with colored diffs and decoded KV cache hints; full payload viewer opens in a side modal for deep inspection.
We intentionally avoid auto-suggested fixes in v1; instead, surface diagnostics and a 'suggested retry-policy' flag for the operator to adopt after triage.
tradeoffs: Accuracy vs performance: Using truncated payload fingerprints may sometimes over-cluster unrelated errors but keeps queries fast for large windows.
Information density: Default collapsed view reduces noise but requires deliberate expansion for low-volume edge-cases — acceptable for first iteration.
Cost visibility granularity: We surface estimated dollar impact per cluster (derived from tokens * pricing) rather than exact invoice-level numbers to avoid confusion from billing adjustments.
accessibility_notes: Color palette uses patterns and high-contrast tokens; timeline lane labels include icons and aria-labels for screen readers.
Keyboard-first navigation: clusters are tabbable and the payload diff supports arrow-key navigation and find-in-diff.
All interactive controls include accessible names and focus styles consistent with Console global styles.
reviewers_feedback: Priya Natarajan (Eng): Prefer collapsing retry stacks by default; asked for explicit API contracts for cluster selection and payload sampling.
Jordan Liu (PM): Wants a canary correlation toggle that overlays traffic percentage and rollout tags on timeline.
Ethan Cole (Observability): Request to include trace IDs for sampled requests and a hook to open traces in the Trace Viewer.
Maya Thompson (SRE): Suggested a quick-action banner to rollback or switch to a safe model variant when cluster cost or error rate crosses threshold.

acceptance_criteria: Timeline aggregates clusters for a 24h window with <= 2s initial render for 50k requests
Clicking a cluster opens payload diff side panel with decoded KV suggestions and ability to copy payload to clipboard
Per-cluster estimated cost displayed and matches cost dashboard within ±10% for sample incidents
Canary overlay displays rollout tags and traffic percentage and can be toggled on/off
Trace IDs for sampled requests link to existing Trace Viewer and open in a new tab
